source_row.rationale: UV light technology is used as an adjunct to, not a replacement for, standard manual terminal cleaning, providing additional pathogen reduction on surfaces after manual cleaning.
source_row.source_detail: UV Light as Adjunct Cleaning Method
source_row.stem: Some facilities use UV light technology as an adjunct to standard terminal cleaning, and a housekeeping supervisor assumes this technology is powerful enough to fully replace the need for the usual manual wipe-down of surfaces. This technology is instead intended to:
